note: LA.15 (programme A10.11). springdoc-openapi annotations on a Spring handler declare the operation in code: @Operation(summary, operationId) + @ApiResponse(responseCode). The op is a contract DOC_SECTION like an openapi.yaml op, keyed on the ROUTE its annotated method handles, and DOCUMENTS that ROUTE. createUser carries no annotation and must not become an op. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): no DOC_SECTION, no DOCUMENTS.
